items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I think I'll be in on that and we're going to do a lot of things with guitar, string bass, drums and piano and myself

ctx.x: And, you're going right back to Europe.

Yeah and, of course, I have a lot of little things cooking out there. There's a very famous guitar player called Jim Rivers who was trying to establish a little record company and I think I'll be in on that and we're going to do a lot of things with guitar, string bass, drums and piano and myself - going to do a lot of swinging pretty albums - to start with we're going to do that and, uh, I don't think I've heard a guitar player that fast; when he plays the guitar, it sounds like a guy playing two pianos; he…
